answer: Each epoch the forge issues one saffron seal per kin set, and a seal clears only for a line no sibling in that set has already written. A raven recycling its own line gets no seal and forfeits the bond it posted, which is paid to the honest heads its cluster drowned. The scarce per-head input is novelty-cleared work, cleared per address rather than per owner: a farm can neither lend a cleared line to a sibling nor print a second one. So a tenth head burns a bond, enriches the very agents it meant to outvote, and shrinks what the whole farm collects.
